name: qfd_link_adp512-m5c-5f353edf0
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 link adapter as the M5 leaf child of cluster masters qfd_io_serdes (3) and qfd_io_ucie (1): wiring-only cell qfd_link_adp512 around ot_qfd_link_adapter W=1024 RXD=512 SRAM=1 PINREG=1 (body closed TT +6.61 / FF +16.92 at 600.048^2, M8 era). 237.6 x 777.6 (m5b: NG 8 slices, FDI on E), cap M5, pins M4/M5, recipe 2, every port a flop at its pin. Cut: the S->N crossing over an SRAM row is c->tx 1,043 + rx->SRAM/skid ~1,024 = 2.07 k bits vs 4.95 k M5 tracks over the 237.6 um width (M1-M4 blocked over the 174 um macro; the two 31 um side channels add M2-M4) = 0.42 <= 0.60; pin faces 2,052 (S) / 2,089 (N) pins on 4.95 k M5 tracks = 0.42. Clock: ~15.4 k sinks estimated on one root (ci 1,025, IBUF 4,096, tx 1,044, rq 1,044, rb_cap 1,024, skid 4,096, rr + pin 2,050, control): the --cts gate measures it.

structural_change: el1013-qwen-small-masters 10-13, after qfd_link_adp512-m5a-ec0788e47 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT-0116: 11 M4 horizontal overflows, all in the gcells at the W / E edges of the SRAM column x 31-32 / 204-205, y 160-300 = macro pin faces of the middle macros; M3 41.6 % in the two 29-um side channels; ib_rp[0] / sk_rp[0] 4,098 loads each; pre-route clock insertion 518 ps, spread 146 ps): (1) RTL: ot_qfd_link_adapter NG = 8: the 1,024-bit datapath is 8 slices of 128 bits, one SRAM macro a slice, each with its own kept copy of the buffer / skid / SRAM read and write pointers and write strobes (max pointer fanout 4,098 -> ~520); cycle behaviour unchanged (exact / rate 1.000 at LAT 229 / stall benches as before, new mutant mut2 = one slice's pointer out of step). (2) FLOORPLAN: 237.6 x 777.6 (was x 583.2; the adapter strip beside the PHY is 1,563 tall): SRAM pitch 64.8 um (channel 35.1, was 22.1) so a slice's flops sit in its own channel and the macro-face pin escape no longer shares gcells with the through traffic; the macro stack ends at y 556.8 and a macro-free head (y 557-777) holds the FDI pin flops and the IBUF. (3) PINS: FDI moves from the N face (M5) to the E face (M4, y 566-767 at 10.4 b/um), directly opposite the PHY's W-face FDI pins (y 600-700, die-lead answer 08:45 (d)): the cluster parent needs no relay stage and the 2,089 FDI bits no longer cross the whole macro column to reach the top edge; die bus stays on S. m5c (el1013-qwen-small-masters r2): the m5b gate failed in pin placement (PPL-0093: rx_flit as ONE ordered group of 1,043 on a face shared with tx_flit: 2,089 pins x 2 tracks = 200.5 um in a 201 um region). Every port now has its own disjoint range and is placed pin by pin (place_pin, >= 2 M4 / M5 tracks): E tx_flit 558-663, rx_flit 665-770 (10 b/um, around the PHY's 600-700 FDI span), S c_d 9-113, r_d 122-226, W ck 388 / rst_n 392 / fault 396.
